335:t_1:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...So this $$スコート・ラボ$$ is Dr. $$トライア$$'s research facility.」

335:t_1:5.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Yeah, it is. Also known as the town where demons cry.」

335:t_1:7.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Don't tell him lies, $$デュオ$$.」

335:t_1:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「The only one crying is $$クロウ$$!」

335:t_1:9.en:
$n
「Does this $$スコート・ラボ$$ have something to do with that $$クロウ・ブルースト$$ I've heard about?」

335:t_1:10.en:
$$カトル$$
「Yes... $$クロウ$$ is a $$次元獣$$ Buster who works for that lab.」

335:t_1:11.en:
$$デュオ$$
「The $$ブラスタ$$ series he pilots is that fox doctor's own handiwork too.」

335:t_1:12.en:
$$カトル$$
「She's now a super-dimensional physics authority, but during the $$破界事変$$, she specialized in mobile weapon development and $$次元獣$$ countermeasures.」

335:t_1:13.en:
$$スズネ$$
「She helped us in the $$時獄戦役$$ too. She really is impressive.」

335:t_1:16.en:
$n
「No... Seeing her wear that fox mask, I just thought she didn't look like such an eminent scientist...」

335:t_1:17.en:
$$スズネ$$
「We've got a goofball wearing a cool guy's skin too, so why not?」

335:t_1:22.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Good for you. It looks like you've stopped being the quiet type.」

335:t_1:25.en:
$$カレン$$
「But it's a relief that Dr. $$トライア$$ took us in and offered to back us up.」

335:t_1:26.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Though $$セントラル・ベース$$ is intact, $$連邦軍$$ and Imperial forces are still evenly matched in North America. We should find other allies too.」

335:t_1:27.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Brigadier General $$マネキン$$ is there too. She's Lieutenant $$パトリック#colasour$$'s wife.」

335:t_1:30.en:
$$五飛$$
「I agree with $$ヒイロ$$. With most of $c missing, the tide of battle will gradually favor the Empire.」

335:t_1:31.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's why we have to do our best until Captain $$アムロ$$, $$甲児$$ and the others come back.」

335:t_1:32.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That's right. At this point, we can't be picky, even if our benefactor is that fox doctor.」

335:t_1:33.en:
$n
「You seem pretty harsh on Dr. $$トライア$$, $$デュオ$$...」

335:t_1:34.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「He probably feels sorry for $$クロウ$$.」

335:t_1:35.en:
$$カレン$$
「They're pals in the Short Straw Alliance, after all.」

335:t_1:36.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Shut up! That team disbanded ages ago!」

335:t_1:38.en:
$n
「I've heard about them a few times, but they seem to be a team that doesn't want much publicity.」

335:t_1:41.en:
$$クルツ$$
「No... I've been wondering about that Short Straw Alliance too.」

335:t_1:42.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$青山$$ and $$ロックオン$$ kept pestering me to join.」

335:t_1:44.en:
$n
「Will it be revealed at $$スコート・ラボ$$?」

335:t_1:45.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's not what I mean, but...」

335:t_1:46.en:
$$デュオ$$
「We'll probably see him again before long.」

335:t_1:51.en:
$$研究員$$
「...Welcome to $$スコート・ラボ$$. We will begin servicing your machines immediately.」

335:t_1:52.en:
$$研究員$$
「I have been entrusted with showing you all around. I ask for your cooperation.」

335:t_1:53.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Is Dr. $$トライア・スコート$$ away?」

335:t_1:54.en:
$$研究員$$
「To spread the risk, the doctor is conducting her research at a separate facility.」

335:t_1:56.en:
$$スザク$$
「Dr. $$トライア$$ played a big part in our destruction of the $$時の牢獄$$.」

335:t_1:57.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Since the Empire is likely watching her too, we should exercise the highest level of vigilance.」

335:t_1:58.en:
$$研究員$$
「That's right. The residents evacuated on orders from the $$連邦軍$$, and the town is already almost deserted.」

335:t_1:59.en:
$$研究員$$
「Only lab personnel are in this area now.」

335:t_1:61.en:
$$研究員$$
「Yes... Thanks to that, even our dangerous research is progressing well.」

335:t_1:62.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Dangerous research, huh... That's no joke coming from someone who works for that fox doctor.」

335:t_1:63.en:
$$研究員$$
「To welcome you today, the doctor has sent an emissary here.」

335:t_1:65.en:
$$研究員$$
「Then let me show you the way.」

335:t_1:69.en:
$$デュオ$$
「We thought you were missing, but you were with that fox doctor?!」

335:t_1:71.en:
$$桂$$
「Well... A beautiful woman invited me too. I couldn't turn her down.」

335:t_1:72.en:
$$モーム$$
「Honestly, $$桂$$! You're making those jokes again!」

335:t_1:73.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Did Dr. $$トライア$$ invite you because you're a $$特異点$$?」

335:t_1:74.en:
$$桂$$
「You're sharp as ever, $$ロジャー$$. That's right.」

335:t_1:75.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So you were helping with her research.」

335:t_1:76.en:
$$桂$$
「Even after we destroyed the $$時の牢獄$$, I had nowhere to return to...」

335:t_1:77.en:
$$桂$$
「And $$サイデリアル$$ seemed pretty hot for me, chasing me around. So I accepted the doctor's invitation.」

335:t_1:78.en:
$$カトル$$
「But if you're here now, $$桂$$, has the doctor's research reached a stopping point?」

335:t_1:80.en:
$$クルツ$$
「'Apparently'? You don't know what the research was about either?」

335:t_1:81.en:
$$桂$$
「Nope. I was pretty much a guinea pig.」

335:t_1:82.en:
$$桂$$
「But keeping the doctor company was harder than I expected. I'm relieved to be free again.」

335:t_1:85.en:
$$桂$$
「With $c in such a tight spot, things would be hopeless without a hero.」
